event.title: IRU Monday Intervals
event.body:
Monday Intervals
📍 Outer Track, Sports Complex (Please use gate no 4, opposite to Gun Club
🕕 Meeting: 6:20 PM | Start: 6:30 PM
👤 Leader: Masood — Speed Squad

A weekly speed-focused session designed to improve speed, endurance, running form, and overall fitness through structured intervals and recovery periods.

All levels are welcome, from beginners to experienced runners. Sessions are adapted to different abilities and paces.

Please arrive on time. We will not wait for latecomers.
Free & open to everyone.

Be there or be square!
#Islamabadrunwithus
